notes.title: Nipi Demo V0.1 is now available!
notes.notes:
[h1]🎉 Nipi Demo V0.1 is Live! 🎮🐾[/h1]

We’re thrilled to announce that the very first public demo of [b]Nipi[/b] is now available on Steam!

This V0.1 release gives you a first look into the world of Nipi — our cozy-but-challenging 3D platformer. Expect curious creatures, tricky jumps, and a world full of little surprises. It’s not a kids’ game, but it’s made for the young at heart.

[h2]🧪 Why a Demo?[/h2]
This demo acts as a free form of early access! It’s a testing ground for gameplay, feel, and fun. We’ll be updating it regularly in the beginning, but once the main game enters paid Early Access, this demo will be updated less frequently.

[h2]💬 Tell Us What You Think[/h2]
We want your feedback!
Join the discussions, report bugs, or share your suggestions right here on the community forums:

👉 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3629810/discussions/]Steam Community Discussions[/url]

[h2]🐞 How to report bugs & feedback[/h2]

If you encounter any bugs or just want to share your thoughts on the game, head over to our Steam Community forums! We’ve prepared a welcome post with clear instructions to help you:

👉 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3629810/discussions/1/601904634461754951/]How to Report Bugs & Give Feedback[/url]

Your input really helps us polish the game and make Nipi the best it can be.

[h2]💙 Thank You[/h2]
This is just the beginning — we’re incredibly excited to share Nipi with you and build this adventure together!

— [i]The Nipi Dev Team 🐉✨[/i]
